verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a public Create Campaign endpoint ([klaviyo-docs-7]) authenticated with scoped private API keys or OAuth ([klaviyo-docs-1], [klaviyo-docs-22]), so creating a campaign without the dashboard is evidenced. Its MCP server also supports campaign creation ([klaviyo-docs-33]). However, nothing in the pack shows an API for scheduling or triggering the send, so only half the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented campaign scheduling/send endpoint, evidence that content/templates and audiences can be attached via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
